# Texas Instruments adapter

Uses TI's public WEBENCH CAD landing page at `https://webench.ti.com/cad/`, not Ultra Librarian. The landing page has a normal HTML form posting `partno` to `/cad/cad.cgi`; the response contains direct `/cad/dlbxl.cgi/TI_BXL/...bxl` and `/cad/dlbxl.cgi/newstep/...stp` links. The former `pf_cad_data.txt` endpoint returned 404 during live validation. No JSON API, pagination contract, or stable bulk-query contract was established, so `config/ti-prefixes.txt` bounds normal public prefix searches. The adapter excludes the 111 MB `ULib.zip` reader installer and detects BXL/STP/ZIP types. STEP names are package-level; the parser carries the preceding MPN row. `eda-fetch ti --limit N` limits unique parts and acquires all selected assets; `--models-only` restricts acquisition to STEP/STP and `--dump-discovery` prints candidates.
